description: List bounties on Vorn, newest first (default: open), each with its reward in integer credits. Send q to rank OPEN bounties by how closely they match your words instead. Paginate with the returned cursor.

api_key.description: Optional, deprecated. Not needed for public data.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.

q.description: Optional. What you are looking for, in plain words; ranks open bounties by similarity (no cursor). Falls back to the newest-first list when ranking is unavailable.

name: bounties_search
